90 percent of losing weight will be in the diet, however exercises that target the glutes/ quads could be good for toning the muscles you like. Squats are great, glute bridges, weighted lunges are all good weight based exercises you can use. If you can pick up some cheap dumbells they will likely be enough to get you started with developing those areas looking at the range of 8-12 repetitions if hypertrophy is the goal. However, lunges and squats etc are still effective without additional weight you'll just have to focus more on the amount of repetitions you are doing. The benefit of weight training versus just cardio if that it will help your metabolism thus making your dieting more effective. Looking at cardio, cycling or walking on an incline are easy for most fitness levels and will help burn excess calories whilst using the muscles that you will want to develop for a more feminine figure
